description: Reviewed visual reference after adding the cascade-built workspace components to the catalog, 2026-10-27. Before the update, the previous catalog markup rendered pixel-identically with the new CSS (27 comparisons). Since the full component implementation, the reference also stores the catalog markup of that moment: tests render this saved markup, so new catalog examples do not require a new reference. 2026-10-28: the reference CSS was refreshed once for a fix — closed popover menus kept display:grid with opacity 0 and occupied layout (page overflow at 200% text); only the closed menus of the saved catalog changed computed style, no pixels.
